tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: A bidder quoting for items under import license shall produce all the above mentioned documents except the Performance Certificate. Further the bidder should produce the following documents as formalized as per the prevailing international norms or bilateral agreements between India and the exporting country
Affidavit

Annual Turnover Statement issued on or after 01-04-2026 for preceeding 3 years 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 i.e. from 01.04.2023 to 31.03.2026 issued by the concerned Charted Accountant/Auditor as per Annexure-II

As the bid documents are digitally signed by the bidder while submitting through e-Procurement portal, it is understood that the bidder had signed all the documents including the tender documents within the meaning of digital signature under IT Act 2001
Attested copy of the Balance sheet and Profit & Loss A/c of the Bidder audited by a Chartered Accountant for Last three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26
Attested copy of the Income Tax returns filed by the Bidder for the last three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26
Attested PAN CARD copy of the Bidder
Capacity Installation Certificate issued by Drug Controller/chartered accountant, not older than 10 months as per Annexure-III

Details of manufacturing Unit duly signed by Authorized Signatory as per the format enclosed at ANNEXURE -IV. Details of Manufacturing Unit should clearly mention the Manufacturing Capacity of the Unit and the capacity should be adequate to supply the tendered quantity within the stipulated period
Earnest Money Deposit/ Bid security
Form of Authorization from Manufacturers as per Annexure-XII

Latest GST payment receipt as per Annexure-I or in the valid format of the commercial tax department for previous financial year issued by the concerned authorities is to be uploaded along with GST registration certificate and GST returns for the month of August2026

List of Items supplied to various State / National / International Agencies with quantities including Supply to Programs sponsored by W H O / UNICEF during the financial years 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 i.e. year ending on 31/03/2024, 31/03/205 and 31/03/2026, if any
List of Kits / items quoted for by the bidder as per Annexure-IV A

Original Market Standing Certificate issued by the Drug Controller for preceding three years 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 i.e. year ending on 31-03-2024, 31-03-2025 and 31-03-2026 as per Annexure-V. The certificate should have been issued on or after 01-04-2026

Original No Conviction Certificate issued on or after 01-04-2025 or not older than 10 months from the date of Tender Notification for preceding 3 years i.e. from 01.04.2023 to 31.03.2026 issued by the concerned Kits Control authorities /Licensing Authorities Annexure-VII

Original Performance Certificate for preceding three financial years 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26 i.e. year ending on 31-03-2024, 31-03-2025 and 31-03-2026 issued by the Competent Authority exercising powers under Kits and Cosmetic Act and Rules, licensing authority as per Annexure-VIII. Issued on or after 01.04.2026
Price Preference to SSI

Primary Manufacturers Original Manufacturing License along with List of Products permitted is to be uploaded. / If AUTORISED AGENTS, DISTRIBUTORS OR IMPORT LICENSE HOLDERS case of imported should also upload Manufacturer licence, No conviction, Capacity Installation, Annuall turnover statement, Details of Manufacturing unit, Original Market Standing and Performance of the primary manufacturer.
Tender declaration form 13 B
Tender Offer Form As per Annexure-X

Wholesale Drug license- Original / Notarized copy of the Wholesale license issued under the Kits & Cosmetics Act 1940 and rules, duly renewed up to date along with products deal is to be uploaded if Tenderer is an Authorized Agent/Distributors
